title: Season 11 The Dao of Hundred Schools Full Preview
contents: [p]Season begins on October 15 at 11:00(UTC+8)![/p][h2][b]Balance Adjustments[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fire Spirit - Burn to Ashes (Five Elements Alliance, Incarnation Phase): Reduce enemy’s HP & Max HP by 12/15/18 → 9/12/15.[/p][/*][*][p]Earth Spirit - Chasing Dust Step (Five Elements Alliance, Incarnation Phase): Def +2/8/14 → 0/5/10.[/p][/*][*][p]Water Spirit - Falling Rain (Five Elements Alliance, Incarnation Phase): HP & Max HP +8/10/12 → 10/13/16.[/p][/*][*][p]Wind-Riding Flash (Lingyu Immortal Fate exclusive card, Immortality Phase): For every 1→2 Agility, deal 1 damage (doubled after self reaches Incarnation Phase).[/p][/*][*][p]Weaken Fulu (Fuluist, Immortality Phase): Apply 2/3/4 → 3/4/5 stacks of Weakness.[/p][/*][*][p]Falling Paper Clouds (Painter, Immortality Phase): Def +18/26/34 → 20/28/36, or +14/20/26 → 20/28/36 HP.[/p][/*][*][p]Echo Formation (Formation Master, Incarnation Phase): Added effect: HP & Max HP +2/5/8.[/p][/*][*][p]Meru Formation (Formation Master, Incarnation Phase): Added effect: Def +2/6/10.[/p][/*][*][p]Everything is Unadvisable (Fortune Teller, Immortality Phase): Def +4/5/6 → 6; Opening: Def +4/5/6 → 4/6/8.[/p][/*][*][p]Cycle of Fate (Fortune Teller, Incarnation Phase): HP & Max HP +8/12/16 → 10/15/20.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Other season information[/h1]
